decisions: Article47 requires aggregation across employers before the deduction schedule, with KRW20m cap. Exempt and daily-worker pay require separate classification.
Article59 credit depends on tax attributable to employment and statutory salary cap phaseouts. Mixed-income total tax cannot simply replace employment-attributable tax.
Keep exact decimal component results. The reference implementation floors components to won, but its behavior alone does not establish the legally required return-level rounding order.
Special employment reductions require additional interaction rules; explicit scope verification prevents treating an unadjusted reference as final credit.

Resolved Article59-2 discrepancy against Act21548 supplementary Article2: 2026 transition is age9, but the entire 2017 birth cohort is excluded from that transition and retains the general age13 requirement. Do not apply either age8 or age13 universally to 2026.

Child-credit references now derive regular credit from qualifying records, preserve the 2017 exception, and separately compute verified current-year birth/adoption credits. Basic deduction eligibility and claimant allocation remain explicit verified inputs; no automatic refund or final credit utilization is claimed.
